messages:
Alex: Kicking off kubeadm cluster bring-up in eu-central4 for the new inference-gpu fleet. Plan: 3 control-plane nodes (standard CPU) + 6 worker pools split as: 2 general-purpose, 2 preemptible-gpu for batch, and 2 reserved-gpu for steady low-latency inference. Surfacing preflight items before terraform apply.

Maria: SGTM. Quick checklist: VPC subnets and regional routing, NAT gateway for pod egress, bastion + IAP for admin access, and outstanding GPU quota requests. Did infra request the quota yet? :eyes:

Cheng: Quota request submitted (case 2026-3312). Cloud approved 12 A100 equivalents; flagged fallback to T4s if A100s are unavailable. Also reserved 10.240.0.0/16 as the peering-safe range to avoid partner overlap.

Alex: Two explicit runbook artifacts I want:
- preflight validator script (node SSH, check kernel modules, containerd config, cgroup settings).
- canonical kubeadm config: ipFamily=IPv4, serviceSubnet=10.96.0.0/12, podSubnet=10.244.0.0/16, controlPlaneEndpoint set to LB vip.

Samir: Ops tweaks: set kube-proxy mode=ipvs, kubelet cgroupDriver=systemd, and set maxPods=110 on control-plane nodes to avoid pod scheduling surprises. IPVS helps with connection churn for high-throughput inference traffic.

Maria: GPU node strategy: taint gpu=true:NoSchedule, label by sku (nvidia.com/gpu=tesla-a100), and nodeAffinity to ensure workload isolation. Preemptible pools only for batch jobs; add a fleet-level policy to fallback to reserved-GPU when preemptible capacity < 20% available.

Cheng: Driver install flow — propose bootstrap snippet to run as part of image/instance-init: 

```
# driver + runtime quick install
apt-get update && apt-get install -y dkms build-essential linux-headers-$(uname -r)
curl -fsSL https://us.download.nvidia.com/tesla/510.47.03/NVIDIA-Linux-x86_64.run -o /tmp/nvidia.run
sh /tmp/nvidia.run --silent --dkms
systemctl restart kubelet || true
```
\nThen assert `nvidia-smi` returns devices and device-plugin daemonset creates Allocatable GPUs.

Alex: Post-join sanity checks: 
- `kubectl get nodes -o wide` (no NotReady)
- confirm kube-proxy ipvs tables present (`ipvsadm -L -n`)
- node-exporter + nvidia-smi exporter metrics appear in Prom
- run a stress-inference pod with 8 concurrent streams against a local small model (target p50 latency < 200ms)
- perform a 10% canary rollout to validate tail latency

Samir: Networking gotcha reminder: asymmetric SNAT when pod egress goes through NAT can break TLS session affinity for some services. Test by curling external endpoints from pods under scale and assert session reuse. Also validate MTU with overlay (we recommend cilium tunnel mode for MTU stability).

Maria: I'll add Terraform targets for cluster-admin role, IAM bindings for service accounts (device plugin, metrics-server, csi-driver). Also will create a `terraform plan` checklist to verify no destructive ops in prod projects.

ops-bot: terraform apply completed for infra-core (plan: 12 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy) @Alex

Alex: Running `kubeadm init --config /etc/kubeadm/cluster.yaml --upload-certs`. Save the join token and CA certs in the secrets store. Workers will join using the printed token.

Cheng: After joins, deploy Cilium v1.16 in tunnel mode (handles previous MTU/overlay issues), then device-plugin daemonset, CSI and metrics stacks (metrics-server, kube-state-metrics). Confirm CNI IPAM layout matches podSubnet.

Samir: Cost note: preemptible GPU nodes reduce hourly costs by ~60% but increase transient failures ~10-15%. For latency-sensitive long-running services prefer reserved nodes; for batch use preemptible with checkpointing and retry. We'll bake Autoscaler policies accordingly.

Maria: Handoff doc plan: create `/docs/infra-runbooks/k8s-eu-central4-onboard.md` with rotate-cert steps, GPU pool scaling procedures, and rollback (cordon -> drain -> re-route traffic to hosted API or smaller model).

Alex: Final opt-in checks before handoff to oncall: RBAC smoke tests, kube-proxy ipvs check, GPU plugin metrics in Prom, and add alerting rule: `GPU utilization > 90% for 5m -> trigger scale-up job`. Also include runbook step to escalate to SRE if control-plane CPU > 80% for 3m.

Samir: I'll run the smoke suite and paste results here. If green, mark as handed off and set `last_message_ts` accordingly. :thumbsup:

Cheng: Noted a kubelet `OOMKill` spike on one init node during `kubeadm init` last night; added note to increase systemd `RuntimeMaxSec` and bump kubelet `--kube-reserved` settings in the runbook.

Alex: Great. Once Samir posts smoke outputs I'll publish the handoff checklist in #eng-oncall and attach the terraform state diff. Thanks all.
